name: Milvus Vector Store
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Milvus node to interact with your Milvus database as vector store[^1]. You can insert documents into a vector database, get documents from a vector database, retrieve documents to provide them to a retriever connected to a chain[^2], or connect directly to an agent[^3] as a tool[^4]
